native_go_source_review.scope: planImageSpan, planMirrorPairs and planRLERuns; source inspection with the above SHA-256 bindings
native_go_source_review.legacy_addresses_role: entry/resume boundaries and ordered compatibility metadata
native_go_source_review.image_control_scope: Typed surface/frame lookup and Go span arithmetic decode, clip and reverse asset packets; CPU model query only normalizes ABI flags. No CPU.Step, opcode dispatcher or effect helper in asset geometry/pixel generation.
native_go_source_review.fade_scope: planFadeDifference and planFadeBlend traverse RGB arrays directly; hardware palette reads/writes and waits remain outside these algorithms
native_go_source_review.color_scope: planFadeColor reads a typed palette index and RGB triplet, builds compatibility arguments and yields at the hardware output boundary; no instruction-effect dispatcher
native_go_source_review.setup_scope: planPaletteList filters used-color data, planPaletteTarget fills RGB triplets and planPaletteError initializes the interpolation array; no opcode or instruction-effect dispatcher
native_go_source_review.row_scope: planImageRow parses a row index, compares signed vertical bounds and calculates the destination using Go geometry; ABI registers, timing and ordered RAM notices are separate; no opcode or instruction-effect dispatcher
native_go_source_review.output_scope: planPaletteOutput decodes one typed index/RGB job and emits HostPaletteWrite for the existing VGA DAC service; generic commit merges device and memory moments without guest opcode dispatch; no CPU.Step in RGB generation
native_go_source_review.palette_control_scope: Typed surface/color arrays, index cursors and RGB jobs; retrace is a two-state bounded data loop using a readonly VGA snapshot; no CPU.Step, guest-opcode dispatch or generated effect block in accepted data processing.
native_go_source_review.primitive_scope: Point coordinates are clipped to the selected surface and indexed through root origin/stride; rectangle pixels are clipped Go intervals and row spans. Source IP tables only preserve ABI/scratch notices, not guest opcode dispatch.
native_go_source_review.axis_and_rows_scope: Go coordinate sorting/clipping emits horizontal spans and a vertical pixel cursor; original eight positions only label ordered notices. Bounded rectangles resume a validated typed row cursor and retain ABI metadata separately; no guest instruction dispatch in geometry or pixels.
native_go_source_review.line_scope: Go coordinate/error arithmetic generates pixels. Typed counters retain the original narrow-tall clip behavior. Source positions label ABI/scratch/model-time notices only; no guest opcode dispatch in geometry or pixel generation.
native_go_source_review.surface_copy_scope: Typed source/destination rectangles and row direction generate word/byte transfers. Go shadow reads preserve overlap dependencies. Fixed IP/step labels preserve notices only; geometry does not dispatch guest instructions.

mirror_normal_player_scope: Only exits explicitly recorded here are observed; controlled calls are not normal player evidence

normal_machine_palette_output.scope: accepted complete RGB output calls; insufficient-budget calls retain original device/ABI boundaries

hardware_contract.scope: standard VGA DAC index and RGB ordering reused through Machine.Out8; pinned model timing, not physical-cycle parity
hardware_contract.status_scope: Existing mode13 input-status approximation reused; no physical-cycle timing claim

primitive_normal_player_scope: Controlled whole routines validate new inputs; counts above identify which exits, if any, occur in this fixed normal DEMO. No new normal-route coverage is inferred.

plan_class_audit.scope: Audits exact source-bound observed copies with empty extra-entry map; original selected-plan test labels included compatibility plans. Pixel/full-machine comparisons remain independent.
